text:
alex: opened PR #4823 to update docs examples — switching from `function-calling` wording to 'action-caller' pattern. I added an example schema envelope and new SDK snippets (py/js). tagging @maya @kevin for review. preview: https://deploy-preview.example.com/4823

maya: skimmed it — nice. question: how strict should the envelope be? do we force `action.name` or allow null? also need fallback parsing guidance for freeform outputs.

kevin: agree on fallback guidance. also the TOC link in /docs/reference still points to old examples — can someone add redirects?

maya: propose envelope: `{"action":{"name":"string","args":{"type":"object"}},"metadata":{"req_id":"string","confidence":0.9}}` — but that's too rigid maybe. I'd suggest making `args` optional and document a parsing fallback that prefers `action` if present else scans for top-level `command`/`intent`.

luis: small nit — in the Python snippet you use `client.call_function(...)` but SDK v0.4 renamed to `client.action_call(...)`. I can push a tiny PR to the snippet file.

sam: deploy-preview for #4823 failed: build logs show 404 on /static/snippets/action-call.js. error snippet path missing in the script.

alex: thanks. I can re-run CI after luis' snippet rename PR. For the fallback section, I drafted a short "parser-first" recommendation: prefer strict JSON envelope; if parsing fails, attempt tolerant regex for \"action\":\\s*\"(\\\\w+)\" then try to map to known actions; log both attempts.

maya: can we add an explicit example showing stepdown to older runtime? like: \"if runtime doesn't support envelopes, send `plain_text` with header `X-Action`\". One-liner with curl example would help.

alex: added curl and server-side handler in PR comments. snippet:

```python
# recommended client usage
resp = client.action_call(model=\"redwood-XL\", input={\"prompt\": prompt}, envelope=True)
if resp.get(\"action\"):
    handle_action(resp[\"action\"])
else:
    # fallback: attempt quick parse
    m = re.search(r'\"action\":\\s*\"(\\\\w+)\"', resp.get(\"output_text\", \"\"))
    if m:
        handle_action({\"name\": m.group(1)})
    else:
        log.warn(\"parse fallback used\")
```

```js
// JS snippet for quickstart
const res = await client.actionCall({model: 'redwood-mini', input: prompt, envelope: true});
if (res.action) {
  routeAction(res.action);
} else {
  // fallback: try JSON.parse then regex
}
```

maya: looks good. also add a short section on guardrails: require `metadata.req_id` for telemetry, and suggest `confidence` thresholds (e.g., >=0.6) before auto-execution.

kevin: QA asked for a "regression test" prompt set — can we add 6 small prompts that exercise envelope/no-envelope, malformed-json, and freeform text? I'll draft and push.

alex: perfect. action items: luis to submit snippet rename PR, kevin to add regression prompts, maya to add guardrail text and schema relaxation paragraph, sam to fix missing static snippet path, alex to re-run CI and merge after checks.

docs-bot: PR #4823 status: changes requested by maya; failing deploy (404); 3 unresolved comments.

alex: pinging @eng-frontend for static file path fix — @sam FYI.

sam: on it, will deploy a quick patch. ETA 2h.

luis: pushed renames in #4826 — updated py/js snippet files. also added alternate example using `envelope=false`.

kevin: pushed regression prompts in #4827.

maya: added guardrail paragraph and softened schema (args optional) in #4830. small doc lint failure fixed.

alex: re-running CI now... looks green ✅, preview updated: https://deploy-preview.example.com/4823

maya: LGTM, good to merge once eng-frontend confirms static fix.

sam: static fix deployed, now 200 on all snippet paths.

docs-bot: PR #4823 ready for merge — merge checks passed.

alex: merging. thanks everyone :tada:
